issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for animal classes (Seal, Pig, Goat): the template's example usage in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java uses two-argument constructors (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the solution repository defines single-argument constructors (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle")). The problem statement's UML also defines Animal with only a single attribute name (UML attribute: "- name: String"), indicating single-argument constructors are expected. This inconsistency can confuse students about the correct constructor signatures to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the examples and specifications consistent. Either (A) update the commented example instantiations in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java in the template to use single-argument constructors (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")) to match the UML and solution, or (B) if an additional attribute was intended, update the problem statement UML and the reference solution to declare and document the extra attribute and add corresponding two-argument constructors to all animal classes. Prefer option A to preserve the current UML and solution.
